cases.situation: Freelance copywriter here. Client wants 12 product pages by Friday but they only sent the product specs yesterday, 4 days late. I need until next Wednesday.
cases.reply: Hi Megan, a heads-up now rather than Thursday night: the product specs arrived yesterday instead of last Wednesday, so all 12 pages by Friday would mean rushing them. I'd like to move delivery to Wednesday the 7th. If Friday is tied to your launch, I'll send the six hero products Friday and the rest Wednesday. Which works better for you?
cases.note: One line of reason, a specific new date, and a partial-delivery trade in case the date is fixed.

cases.situation: 研究生，导师让我周五交论文第三章初稿，但是实验数据要重跑，周五肯定出不来完整的。想申请延到下周三。
cases.reply: 李老师，您好。第三章初稿原定周五交，但上周发现第二组实验的参数设置有误，需要重跑，数据周一才能出来。想跟您申请延到下周三晚上交完整版。如果周五您需要先看框架，我周五可以先把前两节和图表初稿发给您。您看哪种方式合适？
cases.note: 对导师也是同样结构：一句原因、一个具体日期、一个部分交付的备选。

cases.situation: I promised my sister I'd finish her wedding slideshow by Saturday but work exploded this week. Wedding is in 3 weeks so there's slack, just feel bad.
cases.reply: Hey Jess, I said I'd have the slideshow done by Saturday and I'm going to need until next Thursday; I want to do the music timing properly, not rush it. That still leaves two weeks before the wedding. Is that okay, or do you need it sooner for the rehearsal?
cases.note: Personal deadlines get the same shape, just warmer and shorter. No paragraph of guilt.
